test_cases.name: 30 sessions complete
test_cases.input_setup: Launch 30 concurrent mock analysis pipelines through LLMRuntime
test_cases.expected_result: 100% of sessions complete successfully with status 200
test_cases.evidence: All 30 parallel clinical sessions completed successfully with HTTP 200

test_cases.name: No event-loop starvation
test_cases.input_setup: Sample event loop scheduling lag while executing 30 parallel requests
test_cases.expected_result: p99 loop lag < 50 ms across entire execution window
test_cases.evidence: Loop responsiveness preserved during 30-load: p99 lag = 1.27ms < 50ms

test_cases.name: 429 throttling recovery
test_cases.input_setup: Inject 429 rate limit errors on 20% of concurrent sessions
test_cases.expected_result: All sessions recover successfully within <= 4 retry attempts
test_cases.evidence: All 30 sessions succeeded; 6 were throttled with 429 and recovered within <= 4 retries

test_cases.name: Memory stability
test_cases.input_setup: Measure resident set size (RSS) before and after batch processing + GC
test_cases.expected_result: Memory delta < 50 MB; zero runaway object accumulation
test_cases.evidence: Memory stable under high throughput: delta = 0.00 MB < 50 MB

test_cases.name: Graceful shedding at 60 concurrent
test_cases.input_setup: Saturate capacity with 60 simultaneous requests against capacity 20
test_cases.expected_result: Excess load shed cleanly with timeout/rejection; zero unhandled crash
test_cases.evidence: Load shedding verified: 20 admitted, 40 shed gracefully with timeout/503
